description: This file defines the `ExecSystemRunCommandValidator` enum, containing nested structs and enums, as well as static methods, to validate, normalize, and process shell commands and their arguments within a system execution context. It appears to be part of a broader system for command validation and handling in a macOS environment.

classes.name: ResolvedCommand
classes.description: Represents a resolved command with its display string and optional raw evaluation string.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: Represents the result of command validation, either successful (`ok`) with a `ResolvedCommand` or invalid with an error message.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Validates and resolves a command array and raw command string into a validation result with display and evaluation strings.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Checks if the raw command string is allowed based on the command array, considering wrappers and environment manipulations.
